main_argument_chains.claim: Named terrain, fire, forest-watch, and climate sources can supply typed inputs only after reproducible cleaning and coordinate conversion.
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: Freeze snapshots, exclusions, CRS, hashes, and coordinate tests before treating later cells and distances as reproducible.

main_argument_chains.claim: Five SSA sensing geometries can be compared through useful hover time and saturating information revenue.
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: Use the mechanism only after dimensional and geometric replay of Equations (1)-(3).

main_argument_chains.claim: Fire-weighted information revenue and a fleet penalty can organize a conditional SSA placement decision.
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: Retain the fleet result only with normalized objectives, complete constraints, solver status, and feasibility evidence.

main_argument_chains.claim: An EOC can be kept outside burning cells and terrain can be represented in route cost, but the printed algebra needs graph-level verification.
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: Replace or prove Equations (5)-(10) on finite grids before operational routing.

main_argument_chains.claim: A cellular automaton can create an internal fire-severity field when cellwise observed evolution is unavailable.
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: Treat h_ij as an internal scenario until seeds, convergence, process ablation, and held-out spatial validation are supplied.

main_argument_chains.claim: A three-link fitted bridge can turn a ten-year time index into temperature, critical probability, and burned area.
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: Retain p_f=0.79 as a paper scenario until baselines, observations, fit diagnostics, and propagated uncertainty are established.

main_argument_chains.claim: Terrain variation can inform repeater feasibility through a spatial radio-range field.
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: Calibrate Equation (14) against measured propagation before using the range map operationally.

main_argument_chains.claim: Repeater sites and continuous inventory answer different decisions and should remain separate.
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: Require a complete topology, common units, coordinates, solver output, and handoff timeline before procurement.

main_argument_chains.claim: Local lambda/alpha sweeps and stochastic p_f reruns answer different sensitivity questions.
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: Do not call the system robust without global interactions, many replicates, common seeds, uncertainty, and decision stability.

main_argument_chains.claim: The integrated result chain must preserve scenario labels before fleet counts enter decisions.
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: Never merge current 8+2, future/budget 10+2, site counts, active roles, and scheduled/procured airframes.

main_argument_chains.claim: A stakeholder budget is auditable only when quantities, roles, scenarios, prices, currency, and totals reconcile.
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: Rebuild the table in AUD from quotations and model outputs before procurement use.

main_argument_chains.claim: Partial appendix code can bound reproducibility claims even when it cannot reproduce the main conclusions.
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: Do not infer execution, fitting, optimization, sensitivity, or budget outputs beyond the visible fragments.
